description: Schema for the GitLab dependency scanning scan profile configuration

secure_analyzers_prefix.description: Prefix for the container registry from which the analyzer image is pulled.

additional_ca_cert_bundle.description: CA certificate bundle to trust. The bundle is added to the system's certificates and used by other tools during the scan.

secure_log_level.description: Logging level used by the analyzer.

excluded_paths.description: Glob paths excluded from the scan.

include_dev_dependencies.description: Include development and test dependencies when scanning a supported file.

max_depth.description: Specifies the directory depth the analyzer should scan. A value of -1 scans all directories.

pip_dependency_path.description: Path to install Python packages for analysis.

enable_manifest_fallback.description: Enable manifest fallback for dependency scanning.

pipcompile_lockfile_file_name_pattern.description: Custom pipcompile lockfile file name pattern to use when analyzing. The pattern matches file names only, not directory paths.

pip_manifest_file_name_pattern.description: Custom pip manifest file name pattern to use for dependency resolution and manifest scanning. The pattern matches file names only, not directory paths.

enable_vulnerability_scan.description: Enable the vulnerability analysis of generated SBOMs.

api_timeout.description: Vulnerability scanning API request timeout in seconds.

api_scan_download_delay.description: Vulnerability scanning API initial delay in seconds before downloading scan results.

maven_dependency_plugin_version.description: Version of maven-dependency-plugin used during resolution.

maven_args.description: Additional arguments passed to Maven during dependency resolution.

gradle_cli_opts.description: Additional command-line options passed to Gradle during dependency resolution.

disabled_resolution_jobs.description: Resolution jobs to disable. By default, all available resolution jobs are enabled.

maven_resolution_image.description: The image used by the Maven dependency resolution job.

gradle_resolution_image.description: The image used by the Gradle dependency resolution job.

python_resolution_image.description: The image used by the Python dependency resolution job.

pip_index_url.description: Base URL of the Python Package Index.

pip_extra_index_url.description: Additional URLs of Python package indexes to use in addition to pip_index_url.

search_ignore_hidden_dirs.description: Ignore hidden directories when searching for supported files.
